title: Ezekiel Bible Quiz - Chapter 25
description: Ten questions on Ezekiel 25: the words spoken against Ammon, Moab and Seir, Edom and the Philistines.

questions.text: Toward which people was the prophet told to set his face at the start of this chapter?
questions.explanation: He was told to set his face toward the children of Ammon and prophesy against them.

answers.text: Toward the Philistines of the sea coast

questions.text: What word had the children of Ammon said against the sanctuary when it was profaned?
questions.explanation: The reason given is that they said "Aha!" against his sanctuary when it was profaned, and against the land of Israel when it was made desolate.

questions.text: To whom would the children of Ammon be delivered for a possession?
questions.explanation: He says he will deliver them to the children of the east for a possession, who will set their encampments in them and eat their fruit and drink their milk.

answers.text: To the children of the east

questions.text: What does the chapter say Rabbah will be made?
questions.explanation: He says he will make Rabbah a stable for camels and the children of Ammon a resting place for flocks.

questions.text: Which three things had Ammon done against the land of Israel, according to verse 6?
questions.explanation: The chapter says they clapped their hands, stamped with the feet, and rejoiced with all the contempt of their soul against the land of Israel.

answers.text: Burned her fields, cut her trees and stopped her wells
Sent ships, hired soldiers and built forts
Clapped their hands, stamped with the feet and rejoiced
Shut the roads, took the cattle and mocked the priests

questions.text: What had Moab and Seir said about the house of Judah?
questions.explanation: The chapter says Moab and Seir said: behold, the house of Judah is like all the nations.

answers.text: That it is like all the nations
That it has a mighty God
That it will never be rebuilt
That it rules over the sea

questions.text: Which cities of Moab are named as the glory of the country?
questions.explanation: The chapter names Beth Jeshimoth, Baal Meon and Kiriathaim among the cities on his frontiers, the glory of the country.

answers.text: Teman, Dedan and Rabbah of Ammon
Memphis, Zoan and No of Egypt
Sidon, Arvad and Gebal of the sea
Beth Jeshimoth, Baal Meon and Kiriathaim

questions.text: From which place would Edom be made desolate?
questions.explanation: He says he will stretch out his hand on Edom, cut off man and animal from it, and make it desolate from Teman; they will fall by the sword even to Dedan.

questions.text: By whose hand would vengeance be laid on Edom?
questions.explanation: He says he will lay his vengeance on Edom by the hand of his people Israel, who will do in Edom according to his anger and his wrath.

answers.text: By the hand of the Chaldeans
By the hand of the children of the east
By the hand of his people Israel
By the hand of the Philistines

questions.text: Whom would he cut off when he stretched out his hand on the Philistines?
questions.explanation: He says he will stretch out his hand on the Philistines, cut off the Cherethites, and destroy the remnant of the sea coast.
